tab_height = 12.0
hole_diameter = 8.0
chamfer_distance = 1.0

base = Pos(0, 0, block_height/2) * Box(block_width, block_length, block_height)
tab = Pos(block_width/2 + tab_width/2, 0, block_height/2) * Box(tab_width, tab_height, block_height)
result = base + tab
result = result - Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, block_height + 2)
left_edges = result.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z).sort_by(Axis.X)[:2]
result = chamfer(left_edges, chamfer_distance)

part = result
part.name = "block_with_tab"
export_step(part, "output.step")
